text_en: For the labyrinth of the library I designed, I don't know, 50, 60 different labyrinths, studying all the existing labyrinths.
about: Designing the labyrinthine library for 'The Name of the Rose' -- research behind a fictional library, not his own.

text_en: Sometimes, on the contrary, you have to walk through libraries or to places -- places for me is very important -- to visit the places.
about: Using libraries and site visits as part of a novel's research process.

text_en: I am a rare books collector too.
about: Eco describing himself as a rare-book collector.

text_en: And, my collection concerns only... fake books -- books that say the contrary of...
about: The organizing principle of his rare-book collection: books that are wrong/false.

text_en: So I don't have Galileo Galilei but I have Ptolemy, because it was wrong about the movement of the Earth.
about: Example of a 'fake book' in his rare-book collection: Ptolemy over Galileo.

text_en: All together in different places there should be about 50,000.
about: Total estimated size of his book collection across all his residences.

text_en: Here, when I arrived 25 years ago there were 30,000, but since, many of them... I have no more time to count them, but I think there are 35,000.
about: The size and growth of the library specifically in this Milan apartment over 25 years.

text_en: [Interviewer:] Do you have time to read a lot? [Eco:] Another provocative way to answer such a question is: I don't read -- I write.
about: Whether he still has time to read, given his own library and writing.

text_en: There is a cursory reading -- not the quick reading of which... once Woody Allen said: 'I am using the quick reading -- I read "War and Peace" -- he speaks of Russia.'
about: How decades of reading experience let him judge a book quickly; the Woody Allen 'War and Peace' joke.

text_en: There are my books -- translations and... From there to... and they are books on me.
about: Eco gesturing, on camera, at the shelves holding foreign editions of his own books and books written about him -- the library wall filmed right after this remark (see spines_M8IWTOFNlOc.jsonl, wall M8IWTOFNlOc_W4).
